title: Wobble Confessional
description: A bass-led 2-step roller at 134 BPM: a wobbling organ-sub bassline drives a shuffled AkaiLinn breakbeat while a chopped, pitched soul vocal trades hooks with garage piano stabs. It climbs to a peak, drops into a pad-and-vocal valley, then surges to a rawer, denser second peak before delay-tails carry it out.
code:
setcpm(134/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [~ bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").swingBy(0.16, 8).gain(0.9),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("AkaiLinn").cut(1).gain(0.45).hpf(6000),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(200,600)).shape(0.3).gain(0.7)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").swingBy(0.16, 8).gain(0.95),
    s("hh(7,16,2)").bank("AkaiLinn").cut(1).gain(0.5).hpf(7000),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.6),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(4).range(250,900)).resonance(8).shape(0.35).gain(0.75),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("swpad").gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.85)).lpf(1400).room(0.3)

  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").swingBy(0.16, 8).gain(0.95),
    s("hh(7,16,2)").bank("AkaiLinn").cut(1).gain(0.5).hpf(7000).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),

    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(2).range(300,1200)).resonance(10).shape(0.4).crush(8).gain(0.78),
    note("<[eb4,g4,c5] ~ [d4,f4,bb4] ~>").s("piano").gain(0.5).room(0.25).delay(".4:.1875:.4"),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8,"0 2 4 6 7 5 3 1").speed("<1 1.5 0.5 1>").gain(0.55).hpf(400).room(0.2)

    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8,"0 1 2 3").speed("<0.5 1>").gain(0.5).room(0.4).delay(".5:.375:.5"),
    s("breath").gain(0.4).room(0.5).delay(".6:.5:.4").slow(2)

  [28, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").swingBy(0.18, 8).gain(1.0).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 1 1 2>")),
    s("hh(9,16,2)").bank("AkaiLinn").cut(1).gain(0.55).hpf(7500).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("oh ~ oh ~ ~ oh ~ oh").bank("AkaiLinn").cut(1).gain(0.4),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.65).off(0.0625, x => x.gain(0.3)),

  [12, stack(

    s("bd ~ sd [~ bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").swingBy(0.16, 8).gain(0.7),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("swpad").gain(saw.slow(4).range(0.2,0.6)).lpf(900).room(0.5).delay(".6:.5:.5"),
